Do You Think This Project Is Overkill?

The Little Mini Who Wouldn’t Quit

One tiny screw. One forgotten computer. An entirely unreasonable solution.

The true story of resurrecting a forgotten 2012 Mac mini to download motorcycle dashcam videos without removing the camera’s memory card. The tiny screw incident happened approximately two years before the Mini came out of its box on a garage shelf.
